description: This PHP file defines the RefundCommand class, a console command for processing refunds for failed projects within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It provides functionality to handle refunds for specific investments or projects, including read-only and actual update modes, and supports forced refunds even when methods are not refundable.
published: Reflection of the 'refund' command and its configuration and execution logic

classes.name: RefundCommand
classes.description: A console command class for processing and managing refunds for failed projects in Goteo, supporting both dry-run and actual refund modes with options for specific investments or projects.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help text for the refund command in Symfony Console.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the refund process, handling investments or projects based on input options, and performs refund operations including status updates and event dispatching.
